_comment: Region-specific pain points and personas (ids prefixed in_/eu_/us_). Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order, within the document's region).

categories.name: NPA classification, SARFAESI & recovery
categories.description: Accounts turning NPA after a few missed EMIs, SARFAESI notices, OTS and restructuring.

categories.name: Mudra, CGTMSE & PMEGP scheme hurdles
categories.description: Branches refusing or delaying Mudra/CGTMSE/PMEGP loans, subsidy delays, scheme charges.

categories.name: Collateral & guarantor demands
categories.description: Banks asking for property papers or guarantors even when collateral-free cover should apply.

categories.name: GST, ITR, CMA & project-report paperwork
categories.description: Repeated document demands: GST returns, ITRs, audited balance sheets, CMA data, Udyam.

categories.name: OD/CC limit cuts, renewals & drawing power
categories.description: Cash-credit or overdraft limits reduced, renewal delays, stock statements, drawing power.

categories.name: Buyers paying late (45-day rule, MSME Samadhaan)
categories.description: Large buyers and PSUs paying late; 45-day/43B(h) rule, MSME Samadhaan cases.
keywords: 45 days|43b|samadhaan|delayed payments?|payment delay|buyer not paying|receivables?|outstanding payment|gem payment

categories.name: TReDS & invoice discounting access
categories.description: Buyers not onboarding to TReDS, high discount rates, invoice/bill discounting.

categories.name: NBFC & fintech loan rates and charges
categories.description: High ROI and processing fees from NBFCs and lending apps; daily/weekly EMIs.
keywords: \bnbfc\b|lendingkart|flexiloans|indifi|bajaj finance|tata capital|neogrowth|processing fee|rate of interest|\broi\b|interest rate|charges

categories.name: CIBIL & CMR rank problems
categories.description: Low CMR rank or personal CIBIL blocking business credit; wrong bureau entries.

categories.name: Branch delays & unresponsive managers
categories.description: Branch managers sitting on files, RM churn, complaints to banking ombudsman.

categories.name: Bounce Back Loan repayments & director liability
categories.description: Struggling with BBL/CBILS repayments, Pay As You Grow, fears over personal liability.
keywords: bounce ?back|\bbbl\b|cbils|pay as you grow|recovery loan scheme|covid loan

categories.name: Personal guarantees & director liability
categories.description: Lenders requiring directors' personal guarantees, debentures or charges over homes.

categories.name: High-street banks declining or closing business accounts
categories.description: Barclays, HSBC, NatWest, Lloyds etc. turning down lending or closing accounts.

categories.name: Overdrafts withdrawn or cut
categories.description: Facilities reduced or withdrawn at review, short notice.

categories.name: Late payment by large customers
categories.description: Big firms paying on 60–120 day terms or late; Late Payment Act claims.
keywords: late payment|paid late|payment terms|(60|90|120) days|late payment (act|directive|interest)|invoice(s)? (overdue|unpaid)|debt recovery

categories.name: Invoice finance & factoring terms
categories.description: Hidden fees, long contracts and termination charges in invoice finance.

categories.name: Merchant cash advances & alternative lenders
categories.description: Costly revenue-based and MCA products from fintech lenders.
keywords: merchant cash advance|\bmca\b|iwoca|funding circle|youlend|liberis|capital on tap|revenue based|alternative lender

categories.name: Government-backed schemes (British Business Bank, KfW, Bpifrance)
categories.description: Access to Start Up Loans, Growth Guarantee Scheme, KfW and other state-backed credit.

categories.name: Rising rates, arrangement & exit fees
categories.description: Higher base rates, arrangement and early-repayment fees.
keywords: interest rate|base rate|arrangement fee|exit fee|early repayment|\bapr\b|expensive|charges

categories.name: Merchant cash advance traps
categories.description: Daily debits, stacking, factor rates, confessions of judgment, reverse consolidation.
keywords: merchant cash advance|\bmca\b|daily (debits?|payments?)|factor rate|stacking|confession of judgment|reverse consolidation

categories.name: SBA 7(a)/504 delays & denials
categories.description: Slow or denied SBA loans, lender requirements, paperwork.

categories.name: EIDL/PPP repayment & forgiveness
categories.description: EIDL hardship, Treasury offset, PPP forgiveness disputes.

categories.name: Personal guarantees & personal credit pulls
categories.description: Lenders requiring personal guarantees, hard pulls on personal credit.
keywords: personal guarantee|personal credit|hard pull|without personal guarantee|ein only|collateral

categories.name: Line-of-credit approvals, limits & freezes
categories.description: Credit lines declined, cut or frozen by online lenders and banks.

categories.name: Building business credit (Paydex, D&B)
categories.description: Hard to build a business credit file; Net-30 vendors, Paydex, Experian Business.

categories.name: Factoring & slow-paying customers
categories.description: Customers on Net-60/90, factoring costs, collections.

categories.name: Loan brokers, fake lenders & upfront-fee scams
categories.description: Brokers and fake lenders charging upfront fees or misrepresenting terms.

categories.name: High APRs, origination & hidden fees
categories.description: Origination fees, high APRs, prepayment penalties.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.
